name: InquiryResult Primitive
description: Defines the InquiryResult frozen Pydantic model and supporting types in primitives/inquiry.py, following the same pattern as Assessment. InquiryResult captures the output of the active inquiry step: when a worker accepts a signal, it decomposes it into dimensions (people, projects, tickets, keywords, sentiment) and queries its context knowledge base for relevant connections. The result is an immutable (frozen=True) primitive that feeds into the downstream assessment pipeline. Parallel dicts are used for dimensions and confidence_scores with a model_validator enforcing key alignment. Temporal fields use ISO 8601 with UTC internally. Shallow-freeze semantics apply — nested mutable containers (list, dict) are not deep-frozen, so hashability is not guaranteed.

types.name: InquiryDimension
types.description: StrEnum defining the five inquiry dimensions used to decompose a signal. Each value serializes cleanly as a dict key string. Uses Python 3.12 StrEnum semantics.

types.name: DimensionConnectionsList
types.description: A list of discovered connection strings for a single inquiry dimension. Each entry is a string identifier referencing an entity (person name, project ID, ticket ID, keyword, or sentiment label) found in the worker's context knowledge base.

types.name: DimensionsMap

fields.name: entries
fields.description: Mapping from InquiryDimension enum value (str key) to DimensionConnectionsList. Keys must be valid InquiryDimension variants.

types.description: A dict mapping each InquiryDimension to a list of discovered connection strings. Represented as dict[InquiryDimension, list[str]]. All five dimension keys need not be present — only dimensions with discovered connections are included.

types.name: ConfidenceScoresMap

fields.name: entries
fields.description: Mapping from InquiryDimension enum value (str key) to float confidence score. Every value must satisfy 0.0 <= v <= 1.0.

types.description: A dict mapping each InquiryDimension to a confidence score float in [0.0, 1.0]. Keys must be a subset of (and validated to be exactly equal to) the keys present in the sibling dimensions field.

types.name: InquiryResult

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this inquiry result. Generated via UUID4 default_factory (uuid.uuid4().__str__()). Immutable once set.

validators.error_message: id must be a non-empty string

fields.name: signal_id
fields.description: References the originating Signal that triggered this inquiry. Must correspond to a valid Signal.id in the system. Used for merge detection via signal ID set intersection (not embedding similarity).

validators.error_message: signal_id must be a non-empty string

fields.name: context_id
fields.description: References the accepting worker's Context knowledge base that was queried during inquiry. Must correspond to a valid Context.id.

validators.error_message: context_id must be a non-empty string

fields.name: dimensions
fields.description: Dict mapping InquiryDimension enum values to lists of discovered connection strings. Only dimensions with at least zero connections are included. Keys must be valid InquiryDimension variants. Values are lists of string identifiers found in the worker's context knowledge base.

fields.name: confidence_scores
fields.description: Dict mapping InquiryDimension enum values to confidence floats in [0.0, 1.0]. A model_validator(mode='after') enforces that the key set here is exactly equal to the key set in dimensions. Each value is validated to be in the closed interval [0.0, 1.0].

validators.expression: all(0.0 <= v <= 1.0 for v in value.values())
validators.error_message: All confidence scores must be in the range [0.0, 1.0]

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: ISO 8601 formatted UTC timestamp recording when this inquiry result was produced. Generated via default_factory=datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(). All temporal fields use ISO 8601 with UTC internally per engineering decisions.

validators.error_message: timestamp must be a valid ISO 8601 datetime string

types.description: Frozen Pydantic BaseModel (model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True)) representing the output of the active inquiry step in the mesh routing pipeline. Produced by the single accepting worker after signal acceptance and before consensus. Immutable at the shallow level — nested mutable containers (list values in dimensions, dict itself) are not deep-frozen, so instances are NOT guaranteed hashable. Follows the same pattern as Assessment primitive. Exported from primitives/__init__.py.

types.name: InquiryValidationError

fields.name: field_name
fields.description: The name of the field that failed validation.

fields.name: message
fields.description: Human-readable description of the validation failure.

fields.name: invalid_value
fields.description: String representation of the value that failed validation.

types.description: Error detail returned when InquiryResult construction or validation fails.

types.name: InquiryResultList
types.description: A list of InquiryResult instances, typically collected from a single worker's inquiry step.

types.name: OptionalInquiryResult
types.description: An optional InquiryResult — None when inquiry produced no connections.

functions.name: create_inquiry_result
functions.description: Construct and validate a new InquiryResult frozen instance. Applies all field validators (non-empty IDs, confidence range [0.0, 1.0], ISO 8601 timestamp) and the model_validator ensuring confidence_scores keys exactly equal dimensions keys. Returns the frozen, immutable InquiryResult. This is the primary factory entrypoint — callers should prefer this over direct constructor access to ensure all cross-field invariants are checked.

inputs.name: signal_id
inputs.description: The originating Signal's unique identifier. Must be non-empty.

validators.error_message: signal_id must be a non-empty string

inputs.name: context_id
inputs.description: The accepting worker's Context unique identifier. Must be non-empty.

validators.error_message: context_id must be a non-empty string

inputs.name: dimensions
inputs.description: Dict mapping InquiryDimension values to lists of discovered connection strings. Keys must be valid InquiryDimension variants.

inputs.name: confidence_scores
inputs.description: Dict mapping InquiryDimension values to confidence floats. Keys must exactly match dimensions keys. All values must be in [0.0, 1.0].

inputs.name: id
inputs.description: Optional explicit UUID string. If not provided, a new UUID4 is generated via default_factory.

inputs.name: timestamp
inputs.description: Optional explicit ISO 8601 UTC timestamp. If not provided, current UTC time is used via default_factory.

error_data.detail: signal_id must be a non-empty string

functions.name: get_dimension_connections
functions.description: Retrieve the list of discovered connections for a specific dimension from an InquiryResult. Returns the connection list if the dimension exists, or an empty list if the dimension is not present in this result's dimensions map.

inputs.name: dimension
inputs.description: The dimension to look up. Must be a valid InquiryDimension variant.

error_cases.name: invalid_dimension
error_cases.condition: dimension is not a valid InquiryDimension variant

error_data.detail: dimension must be a valid InquiryDimension variant

preconditions: inquiry_result is a valid InquiryResult instance
dimension is a valid InquiryDimension variant
postconditions: If dimension is a key in inquiry_result.dimensions, returns inquiry_result.dimensions[dimension]
If dimension is not a key in inquiry_result.dimensions, returns an empty list

functions.name: get_dimension_confidence
functions.description: Retrieve the confidence score for a specific dimension from an InquiryResult. Returns the float confidence if the dimension exists, or 0.0 if the dimension is not present.

inputs.name: dimension
inputs.description: The dimension whose confidence score to look up.

error_cases.name: invalid_dimension
error_cases.condition: dimension is not a valid InquiryDimension variant

error_data.detail: dimension must be a valid InquiryDimension variant

preconditions: inquiry_result is a valid InquiryResult instance
dimension is a valid InquiryDimension variant
postconditions: If dimension is a key in inquiry_result.confidence_scores, returns inquiry_result.confidence_scores[dimension]
If dimension is not a key in inquiry_result.confidence_scores, returns 0.0
Return value satisfies 0.0 <= result <= 1.0

functions.name: get_active_dimensions
functions.description: Return the set of InquiryDimension values that have at least one connection in the InquiryResult's dimensions map. Useful for determining which dimensions the inquiry step actually populated.
preconditions: inquiry_result is a valid InquiryResult instance
postconditions: Returned list contains only valid InquiryDimension variants
Every element in the returned list is a key in inquiry_result.dimensions where len(connections) >= 1
Dimensions with empty connection lists are excluded

functions.name: get_overall_confidence
functions.description: Compute the mean confidence score across all dimensions present in the InquiryResult. Returns 0.0 if no dimensions are present. This provides a single summary confidence value for the entire inquiry result.

inputs.name: inquiry_result
inputs.description: The InquiryResult whose mean confidence to compute.

preconditions: inquiry_result is a valid InquiryResult instance
postconditions: If inquiry_result.confidence_scores is empty, returns 0.0
Otherwise returns sum(confidence_scores.values()) / len(confidence_scores)
Return value satisfies 0.0 <= result <= 1.0

functions.name: serialize_inquiry_result
functions.description: Serialize an InquiryResult to a JSON-compatible dict. InquiryDimension enum keys are serialized as their string values for clean JSON output. This uses Pydantic's model_dump() under the hood with mode='json'.
preconditions: inquiry_result is a valid InquiryResult instance
postconditions: Returned dict contains keys: id, signal_id, context_id, dimensions, confidence_scores, timestamp
All InquiryDimension enum keys are serialized as plain strings
dimensions values are lists of strings
confidence_scores values are floats in [0.0, 1.0]
timestamp is an ISO 8601 UTC string
Returned dict is JSON-serializable

functions.name: deserialize_inquiry_result
functions.description: Deserialize a JSON-compatible dict into a validated InquiryResult instance. Uses Pydantic's model_validate() to parse and validate all fields, including cross-field key alignment. String keys in dimensions and confidence_scores are coerced to InquiryDimension enum values.

inputs.description: A JSON-compatible dict with keys: id, signal_id, context_id, dimensions, confidence_scores, timestamp.

invariants: InquiryResult instances are always frozen (model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True)) — field assignment after construction raises TypeError
For any valid InquiryResult r: set(r.confidence_scores.keys()) == set(r.dimensions.keys()) — enforced by @model_validator(mode='after')
For any valid InquiryResult r: all(0.0 <= v <= 1.0 for v in r.confidence_scores.values()) — enforced by @field_validator
For any valid InquiryResult r: all(isinstance(k, InquiryDimension) for k in r.dimensions.keys())
For any valid InquiryResult r: r.id is a non-empty string (typically UUID4 format)
For any valid InquiryResult r: r.signal_id is a non-empty string
For any valid InquiryResult r: r.context_id is a non-empty string
For any valid InquiryResult r: r.timestamp is a valid ISO 8601 UTC datetime string
InquiryDimension has exactly five variants: people, projects, tickets, keywords, sentiment
Shallow-freeze semantics: nested mutable containers (list values in dimensions dict, the dicts themselves) are not deep-frozen — InquiryResult is NOT guaranteed hashable
serialize_inquiry_result followed by deserialize_inquiry_result produces a value-equal InquiryResult (round-trip fidelity)
All temporal fields use ISO 8601 with UTC timezone internally
